metadata.description: Pure offline trajectory-execution and command-safety preparation layered on frozen Real Global Path Tracking V1 Shadow Mode.
metadata.stage: Real Global Path Execution & Safety V1 — OFFLINE ONLY
metadata.calibration_status: INITIAL SAFETY GATE / NOT CALIBRATED. No physical-motion performance or safety certification is claimed.

execution_plan.one_lap_adapter: Use the existing canonical two-lap runtime. At each periodic-lap progress sample, retain the stricter of the first-lap launch envelope and second-lap terminal-stop envelope, then reuse the canonical timing/acceleration helper. Geometry, periodic speed limits, and dynamic limits remain unchanged.

initial_start_alignment_gate_not_calibra.rationale: Provisional offline-only values make START_POSE_MODE decisions deterministic while keeping translation and heading independent. They are not measured stopping/tracking tolerances and must be reviewed with stationary live localization before any physical command Stage.

physical_execution_readiness.reason: The canonical one-lap reference clock exceeds the provisional real-safe body, yaw-rate, and track-speed command envelope and must not be connected directly to a physical publisher.
physical_execution_readiness.diagnostic_policy: Report the maximum of canonical peak divided by the corresponding provisional real-safe cap as a uniform time-scale lower bound. This proves the current clock is incompatible; it is not an optimized or validated physical trajectory timing.
next_stage_sequence: measure physical command sign, deadzone, and speed capability
freeze the measured physical command envelope
generate a real-safe reference with the SAME rounded geometry and SAME trajectory-generation logic
execute that SAME real-safe reference in Isaac and Real
compare Sim Actual and Real Actual

orderly_stop.planned_stop_policy: Use the canonical terminal deceleration envelope.
orderly_stop.explicit_early_stop_policy: Scale the already real-safe candidate toward zero using the unchanged canonical maximum deceleration; preserve the canonical and real-safe candidates as diagnostics.

row_source_semantics.POSE_UPDATE: A future row generated directly by a /localization/pose callback; only this source may contribute independent samples to tracking-performance metrics.
row_source_semantics.STATUS_TIMER: A non-progressing periodic safety/watchdog evaluation; preserve it but exclude it from tracking-performance weighting.
row_source_semantics.RECORDED_POSE: A frozen Shadow V1 recorded-audit row; never treat it as rounded-loop tracking performance.
row_source_semantics.OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC: A deterministic exact-reference pose used only by this offline execution/safety Gate; it is not real tracking performance.
